description: This file defines the AccessPolicyInterface in Drupal, specifying methods for access control policies including permission calculation, application scope, permission alteration, and cache context management.

classes.name: AccessPolicyInterface
classes.description: Interface for defining access policies in Drupal, including methods for scope checking, permission calculation, permission alteration, and cache context retrieval.

methods.name: applies
methods.description: Checks whether this access policy applies to a given scope.

methods.name: calculatePermissions
methods.description: Calculates permissions for a user account within a specified scope.

methods.name: alterPermissions
methods.description: Modifies the calculated permissions, typically to revoke permissions or enforce restrictions.

methods.name: getPersistentCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns cache contexts that influence the access policy's calculations.
